name: National Hellenic Museum
tagline: A small museum in Greektown chronicling the Greek-American experience. Worth pairing with dinner nearby.
description: Located in the heart of Greektown on the West Loop. Permanent exhibits on the immigrant experience, ancient Greek artifacts on rotating loan, and an oral history archive of Greek-American voices. Best paired with dinner at Greek Islands or The Parthenon.

tips.text: Combine with dinner — the museum is on the same block as Greektown's best tavernas.
